description: Eight stereo fade gates, each raising and lowering its pair of channels on a gate, with its own fade-in and fade-out times

params.text: Sets how long that row takes to fade up once its gate goes high, 0.05 to 40 seconds
Sets how long that row takes to fade down once its gate goes low, 0.05 to 40 seconds

inputs.text: A gate of 0.01V or more fades that row up and dropping it below that fades the row down; with nothing patched the row follows its own fade button
The left input of that row, passed through the row's fade
The right input of that row, passed through the row's fade

outputs.text: The left input of that row after the fade, or the fade shape itself as 0-10V when that input is empty
The right input of that row after the fade, or the fade shape itself as 0-10V when that input is empty

notes: a row whose fade is reversed part way through picks up from where it had reached rather than jumping
the button beside a row's gate input fades the row up and down on its own, so the module can be used with nothing patched to the gate inputs
a row with no audio patched into it puts the fade shape itself out as 0-10V, which makes it an envelope generator with no input
